notes: "Kecepatan tumbuh" is fine, but "layout" could be "tata letak" for natural Indonesian. This is minor.
"liverwort" is left in English; consider adding the Indonesian "lumut hati" in brackets for readers who don't know the term. This is minor.
"rata-rata tinggi setelah dua bulan" reads slightly awkwardly; "tinggi rata-rata setelah dua bulan" is more natural.
"aquarist" is left in English; use "aquascaper" or "penghobi akuarium" instead.
"Daunnya" for "fronds": duckweed has thalli, not true leaves. This is acceptable, but "talus" or "daun" is fine and not a real error.
"Kebutuhan cahaya": "Tuntutan cahaya" is not needed. The current wording is fine.
Item 9: "White Mountain minnow (white cloud)" adds an alias that is not in the source. Keep only the name, or use the common local name.
Item 9: "Karena lembut dan disukai pemakan tanaman" is a loose rendering of "delicate and palatable". Something like "Karena daunnya lembut dan enak dimakan" is clearer.
Item 4: "Be sure to have the habitat ready before purchase" is translated as "Pastikan tempatnya sudah siap". "Tempatnya" is vague. Use "habitatnya" or "akuarium/penataannya".
Item 5: "family Isopterygium" is kept as written, but Isopterygium is a genus, not a family. The source error is carried over. Consider "genus" if the translator may correct it, or flag it.
Item 3: "diikat ke kayu" is fine, but "Attaching" could be "ditempelkan/diikat". "menyamarkan peralatan" for "hiding installations" is slightly narrow. "instalasi/perlengkapan" would be closer.
Item 4: "predator sejati" for "obligate predator" is loose. "predator obligat" or "pemakan ikan murni" would be more precise.
Item 1: "will not swim even an inch" is rendered "hampir tidak mau berenang sedikit pun". The added "hampir" (almost) softens the meaning. Drop it: "tidak akan berenang sedikit pun".

Item 3: "far from being rare" is rendered "sama sekali tidak langka". This overstates the English, which says "far from rare". Use "jauh dari langka" or "sama sekali tidak langka" only if you keep the nuance.

Item 4: The English says the species is widely distributed in South America. This is fine, but the source says "originate from Venezuela" while item 5 lists the type locality as Rio Branco. Check that the specimen origin is consistent.
Item 6: "secluded" is rendered "terlindung dan tersembunyi". The doubled wording is redundant. Use "akuarium yang tenang/terlindung".
Item 7: Sentence structure and meaning are fine. "jelas paling sering" for "most often obviously" is slightly off. Use "tampaknya paling sering", because "obviously" is hedged.
Item 9: "press the tail on the side of the body" is rendered "menekuk ekornya". "Menekuk" (bend) changes "press against". Use "menempelkan ekornya ke sisi tubuh".

Item 11: "slender 2 rayed dorsal fin" is rendered "sirip punggung ramping dengan 2 jari-jari". This is acceptable, but "The Amaralia genus have" should be checked. Also "Least Concern (Berisiko Rendah)" in item 2 is fine.
Item 12: The reference list is left untranslated, which is correct.

Item 1: "will not swim even an inch" became "tidak akan berenang sedikit pun" (will not swim at all). This loses the idea of barely moving and reads as if they never swim. Suggest "hampir tidak mau berenang sedikit pun" or "tidak akan berenang sejauh apa pun".
Item 1: "much reduced dorsal fin" became "sirip punggungnya yang sangat kecil". This is acceptable but loses "reduced". Suggest "sirip punggung yang sangat mengecil/tereduksi".
Item 2: Temperature and pH ranges are unchanged, but "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)" is an odd gloss. Indonesian usage is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Least Concern". Minor.
Item 6: "secluded tank" became "akuarium yang tenang dan terlindung". "tenang" is an added fact. Suggest "akuarium yang tersembunyi/terlindung".

Item 7: "obviously on loricariids" became "tampaknya" (apparently), which weakens "obviously". Also "burayak" for freshly hatched fish is fine, but "dengan kantong kuning telur besar dari spesies ikan lain" is ambiguous about what belongs to what. Suggest rephrasing.
Item 8: "Tablet foods are also taken" is fine. "tubifex" became "cacing sutra", which is acceptable. No change needed here.

Item 11: "slender 2 rayed dorsal fin" became "sirip punggung ramping dengan 2 jari-jari". This is acceptable. "-ia, milik" is a literal rendering of "belonging to" and is awkward. Suggest "akhiran -ia, bermakna 'milik'".
Item 11: "caudal peduncle" became "pangkal ekor (batang ekor)". Prefer the single standard term "batang ekor".
Item 12: The reference list is left untranslated, as allowed.
Item 14: "bisa tersengat panas hingga melukai dirinya" is awkward; use "bisa terbakar" or "melukai dirinya karena panas".
Item 23: "Hanya ada satu laporan pemijahan" is ambiguous. Say "hanya ada satu laporan pembiakan", because the source is about a breeding report, not spawning at large.

Item 23: "No adults were collected in water about 45 cm deep" is rendered fine, but "semi-aquatic reeds" became "alang-alang yang tumbuh di tepi air". Use "alang-alang semi-akuatik" to avoid adding a fact ("tepi air", the water's edge).
Item 22: "Belum berhasil dipijahkan di akuarium" is fine, but "sarang busa" should be "sarang gelembung" (the common hobby term for a bubble nest).

Item 4: "Ada perbedaan warna antara jantan dan betina sampai batas tertentu" is a loose rendering of "sexual dichromatism". Clearer: "dikromatisme seksual" or "perbedaan warna antara jantan dan betina yang tidak terlalu jelas".
Item 16: "Ikan ini bisa makan sampai kekenyangan hingga perutnya tampak seperti mau meledak" is redundant. Say "makan sangat banyak hingga perutnya tampak hampir pecah".
Item 5: "bagus" is weak for "very nice", and "pemula di hobi ini" is stiff. Say "pemula dalam hobi akuarium".
Item 1/24: "Hancock's doradid" and "blue-eyed catfish" are left in English, which is acceptable. "catfish doradid" is mixed. Prefer "lele doradid" or keep "catfish" consistently.
Item 19: "Spesies ini kurang disukai penduduk setempat" is fine. "wading person" -> "orang yang berjalan di air" is okay, but "aduh!" is slightly informal for a handbook.
Item 9: "leaves these retreats to feed in large schools by night" is fine, but item 1/24: "sangat pemalu" for "secretive" changes meaning slightly; use "suka bersembunyi".

Item 23: "Tidak ada ikan dewasa yang tertangkap di air sedalam sekitar 45 cm itu" adds "itu" and a specific context; fine, but "semi-akuatik" for reeds is awkward; use "alang-alang yang tumbuh di tepi air".

Item 22: "sarang busa ... di antara tanaman di permukaan air" is OK, but item 22 says "Belum berhasil dipijahkan" while item 23 says "bertelur dengan cara menyebarkan telurnya" in aquarium. This contradiction comes from the source; make wording consistent without adding facts.
Item 14: "bisa terluka bakar" - use "bisa tersengat panas/melukai dirinya"; "burn themselves" is OK but "heater" is better as "pemanas (heater)".
Item 2: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" fine; "Kesadahan" for Hardness fine.
Item 17: "catfish lain seperti doradid lain" is repetitive; use "seperti doradid lainnya".
Item 18: "cocok dengan sesamanya" is a bit vague for "does well with its conspecifics"; use "akur dengan sesamanya".
Item 5: "sangat menarik" for "very nice" is acceptable but "bagus" is closer.
Item 21: "penghobi" for keepers fine; item 20 "seiring bertambah dewasa" should be "seiring bertambahnya usia/saat dewasa".
Item 24: "mengerutkan dan mengendurkan" fine; "luka yang sangat menyakitkan" for "eye-watering wound" OK.
Item 4: "julukan spesies ogoense" – 'specific epithet' is more standard as "epitet spesifik"; "julukan" is slightly informal.
Item 4: "berhias, sering kali berbentuk lira" is slightly awkward; consider "berhias, sering berbentuk seperti lira".

Item 10: "Less eggs tend to fungus using the latter method" is rendered correctly, but "burayak" for fry is regional/less common. "Anakan" and "burayak" are mixed, so use one term consistently, e.g. "burayak" or "anakan ikan".
Item 10: "jumlah anakan cenderung lebih sedikit" translates "brood sizes". Say "jumlah burayak yang dihasilkan" or "jumlah telur per pemijahan" to be consistent.
Item 10: "peat" is used loosely in "filtrasi dengan peat". Use "filtrasi gambut (peat)" consistently, or keep "peat moss" only for the substrate.
Items 1, 5, 10: "Splendid lyretail" is left untranslated as a common name. Consider adding a local form such as "ekor lira", or keep the English trade name.
Item 10: "menggunakan filter spons kecil ... bukan ide yang buruk" is a clumsy sentence. Add "tetapi" or restructure it: "menggunakan filter spons kecil ... tidaklah buruk".
Item 10: "peternak" for "breeders" is awkward in the aquarium hobby. Use "pembiak" or "penghobi/pembudidaya".
Item 10: "pakan yang lebih besar dan pakan beku" is correct, but "velvet" should be "penyakit beludru (velvet)".
Item 8: "saling teritorial" is awkward. Use "bersikap teritorial satu sama lain".
Item 11: 'Burayaknya' / 'burayak' is the term for fry, which is fine, but 'peternak' for breeders is awkward; use 'pembiak' or 'penghobi' instead.
Item 11: 'air yang diisi ... setinggi 2,5–5 cm' is fine, but 'dibibit' for 'seeded' is awkward; use 'diberi starter pakan' or 'diinokulasi'.
Item 11: 'air harus dibuat sangat dangkal' is fine, but 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' should read 'filter spons yang digerakkan udara (aerator)'.
Items 2/9: 'teman setanknya' is a bit informal; 'penghuni akuarium lain' is more natural.
Item 9: 'ikan cyprinid' and 'Loricariid kecil' are left as English terms; consider 'ikan sejenis Cyprinidae' or the local names.
Item 2/12: 'annual' is left untranslated; consider 'spesies annual (musiman)' for clarity.
Item 12: 'jari-jari ... sirip punggung' is acceptable, but 'garis vertikal' for 'vertical bars' is better as 'pita/garis tegak'.

Item 5: "Asalkan tersedia cukup tempat bersembunyi dan struktur" – English says "cover and structure"; "tempat bersembunyi" is acceptable, but "gua" for caves is better rendered as "gua-gua kecil/celah persembunyian".
Item 5: "ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari; ganti air 10–15% per minggu sudah cukup" is fine, but "kepadatan ikan ... rendah" could be more natural as "tidak padat penghuni".

Item 2: "kota/kabupaten (municipio)" is awkward; use just "kota (municipality) Codajás" or "kotamadya". Also "sedikit di hulu kota Manaus" is slightly vague for "just upstream"; use "tepat di sebelah hulu".
Item 9: "lebih berwarna" is awkward; use "warnanya lebih mencolok". "sirip yang lebih panjang" for "more extended fins" is acceptable.
Item 10: "agresif/galak" with slash is clumsy; choose one, e.g. "sangat agresif". "hyper-aggressive" is also better as "sangat agresif".
Item 11: "Spesies ini juga diberi nomor 'A' A234" is awkward; use "nomor 'A' yaitu A234". "hampir selalu berubah" for "near-constant flux" is fine.
Item 11: "sub-garis keturunan" and "garis keturunan (lineage)" are unnatural for "sublineage/lineage"; consider keeping "sublineage"/"lineage" as the hobby terms.
Item 1: "kali kecil" for creeks is slightly colloquial; "anak sungai kecil" or "sungai kecil" is more standard.
Item 3: 'white' water translated as "air keruh (whitewater)" – whitewater is not simply 'turbid' water; use "air putih (whitewater)" or "air keruh berlumpur (whitewater)" for accuracy.
Item 2: "Saat ini spesies ini diterima tersebar" is garbled; rephrase as "Saat ini diakui sebaran spesies ini mencakup ...".
Item 2: 'upstream from Manaus' – "sedikit di hulu kota Manaus" is ok, but 'municipality' as "munisipalitas" is stiff; use "kota/kabupaten (municipio) Codajás".

Item 10: "Betina yang mengurus telur dan burayak" – 'hyper-aggressive' rendered only as "sangat agresif"; use "sangat agresif/galak" and note she guards fry; also "burayak" is less common than "anakan" among hobbyists.
Item 11: 'lineage' left untranslated and 'near-constant flux' as "hampir selalu berubah" is fine, but "oleh ikan-ikan yang muncul" is awkward; use "dengan tambahan ikan-ikan yang muncul di pasar".
Item 11: "genus cichlid ... dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak" – 'among the most speciose' should be "salah satu ... dengan spesies terbanyak"; current wording implies the single most.
Item 4/1: 'dither' fishes and "kutu air" for Daphnia: Daphnia is commonly "daphnia"/"kutu air"; "ikan dither" should be explained, e.g. "ikan dither (ikan pengalih/penenang)".

Item 11: 'sister group' relationship is described as 'weakly-supported' but the Indonesian puts 'dengan dukungan yang lemah' at the end, which is fine; however 'Crenicichla and Teleocichla ... added' is OK. The real problem: 'Kullander ... Cichlidae divided into six subfamilies' is fine, but 'serangkaian garis keturunan (rumpun)' for 'lineages' is unnatural; use 'linyah/garis keturunan' consisten…

Item 11: 'Hobbyists tend to label these ...' is fine, but 'Masih harus dilihat apakah ketiganya satu spesies' is stiff; use 'Belum diketahui apakah ketiganya merupakan spesies yang sama dengan A. alacrina'.
Item 11: 'klad (clade)' and 'klad crenicarine' are non-standard; use 'klade' and keep the English term in brackets consistently.

Item 1/11: 'Cichlid kerdil bintik merah' is a non-standard rendering of 'redspot dwarf cichlid'; the common Indonesian hobby term is 'cichlid kerdil' with the English trade name, so keep the English name more prominent.
Item 7: 'jentik/larva chironomid (cacing darah)' is clumsy; use 'larva Chironomidae (cacing darah / bloodworm)'. 'kutu air (Daphnia)' is fine but 'jentik' means mosquito larvae and may mislead.
Item 3: 'perairan mati (backwater)' is a loose rendering; 'backwater' is better rendered as 'perairan tenang di tepi sungai'. 'genangan atau kolam kecil' adds 'atau' ambiguity for 'pool'.
Item 5: 'daun beech, oak' leaves untranslated names; use 'daun beech (Fagus), ek/oak'. 'burayak' for fry is acceptable but 'anakan' is more common among hobbyists.
Item 10: 'hyper-aggressive' is softened to 'sangat agresif'; use 'sangat agresif/hiperagresif'. 'pemijah substrat' is fine.
Item 11: 'the putative subfamily Geophaginae' is rendered 'subfamili yang diduga, Geophaginae' – awkward and unclear; rephrase e.g. 'subfamili Geophaginae (yang diusulkan)'.

Item 11: 'Hobbyists ... in order to avoid mixing them and the potential of hybridisation' is OK, but 'Daftar semacam ini terus bertambah ... dan hampir selalu berubah' loses 'augmented by fish' nuance; say 'diperluas dengan ikan-ikan yang muncul di perdagangan'.

Item 11: 'sister to Crenicichla' translated 'kerabat terdekat (sister)' – fine, but 'lineage', 'sublineage', 'klad' left in English/loanwords; use 'garis keturunan/rumpun' and 'klad (clade)' consistently.

Item 3: 'parit/kali kecil' for 'creeks' – 'parit' means ditch/drain, which is wrong; use 'anak sungai kecil'. 'Kubangan' (wallow) for 'roadside pool' is also odd; use 'genangan/kolam kecil di tepi jalan'.
Item 8: ''dither' fishes ... 'ikan kecil sebagai dither fish'' – awkward; use 'ikan kecil penenang (dither fish)'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'chironomid larvae' left as 'larva chironomid'; more natural 'jentik/larva chironomid'. 'Kurang rewel' fine.

Item 1/2: 'Redspot dwarf cichlid' and 'Amazon' left untranslated; use 'Amazon' basin consistently, e.g. 'cichlid kerdil bintik merah'. Item 2: 'bertetangga' for 'neighbouring' is awkward; use 'yang berbatasan'; 'affluent' = 'anak sungai' ok.
Item 4: 'Base dimensions ... acceptable for a single pair' translated 'sudah cukup' ok; 'lembah Amazon' for 'Amazon basin' should be 'cekungan/DAS Amazon'.
Item 11: 'gurat sisi (linea lateralis) ... perkembangannya bervariasi dan sering kali tidak sempurna' word order muddles which is rudimentary; rephrase.
"Sunset-Apistogramma" kept in quotes with hyphen; fine but could be written "Apistogramma Sunset" as hobbyists do.
"dideskripsikan secara ilmiah" is slightly awkward; "dideskripsikan secara resmi" or "sebelum dideskripsikan" is more natural.
Item 11: the English says Farias et al. (1999, 2000, 2001), but the reference list has no 2000 entry. That is a source issue, not a translation error. Nothing to fix here.
Item 8: 'It can be maintained in pairs or groups...' is rendered 'Spesies ini bisa dipelihara berpasangan...'. This is acceptable.
Item 8: the English says the females' spars are 'particularly violent'. The Indonesian 'terutama pada betina yang pertarungannya sangat ganas' keeps this. Fine.
Item 11: 'Geophaginae, sebuah subfamili yang diusulkan' is placed awkwardly. Say 'subfamili yang diusulkan, Geophaginae' or 'putative' as 'yang dianggap/diduga'.
Item 11: 'Teleocichla sudah mapan diketahui sebagai kelompok saudara Crenicichla' is awkward. Use 'sudah diketahui dengan baik sebagai kelompok saudara Crenicichla'.
Item 11: 'sedang dalam warna kawin' for 'nuptial' is slightly loose. Prefer 'individu yang sedang berbiak/berwarna kawin'.
Item 11: 'tempat A. baenschi bernaung' is informal for a technical text. Use 'yang menaungi A. baenschi' or 'yang mencakup A. baenschi'.
Item 11: 'Kullander (1998)' tribe names are given as 'tribus'. 'Tribe' is acceptable, but 'tribus' is not widely used by hobbyists. Optionally use 'tribe'.
Item 11: 'in a state of near-constant flux' is rendered 'hampir selalu berubah'. This is acceptable.
Item 5: 'biologically-immature aquaria' is rendered '(belum cycling)'. This is fine.

Item 8: "betina justru sangat ganas" – English says the fighting among females is particularly violent; "justru" adds a contrast not in the source. Use "terutama pada betina yang sangat ganas" or similar.
Item 5: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – ok-ish, but "biologically-immature" is better as "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".

Item 11: "Para peneliti juga telah mengelompokkan" – English says "authors"; fine, but "Kesimpulan ... hampir selalu berubah" for "near-constant flux" is fine. Real issue: "subfamili Geophaginae yang masih bersifat dugaan" misplaces "putative" – should be "subfamili Geophaginae yang diduga/diusulkan"; ambiguous.

Item 11: "Apistogramma termasuk genus cichlid Amerika Selatan dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak" – OK; but "Teleocichla sudah lama diketahui" adds "lama" not in source ("well-established"); use "sudah mapan diketahui".
Item 12: reference 2000 (Farias et al. 2000) is cited in the text but is not in the list; not a translation error. No issue.

Item 7: "Artemia, Daphnia, Moina" rendered as "kutu air (daphnia, moina)" – Artemia is not Daphnia/Moina grouping error; "kutu air" generalises the wording and "artemia" is lowercase; keep Latin genus names capitalised/italic (Artemia, Daphnia, Moina).
Item 5: "Alder cone" left in English without explanation; add "(kerucut alder)" or "buah alder".
Item 3/Item 1: "cukup sejuk" fine. Item 2: type locality quote left in English is fine.

Item 11: 'a weakly-supported sister group relationship between Acarichthys and Guianacara' is mistranslated. 'dengan dukungan yang lemah' is placed after it, but 'klade Satanoperca' 'dengan dukungan kuat' is placed oddly. Rephrase as 'klade Satanoperca yang didukung kuat'.

Item 11: 'Hobbyists tend to label ... in order to avoid mixing them and the potential of hybridisation' is OK, but 'Para peneliti' for 'authors' is acceptable. 'sebagai genus ... dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak' is fine. 'Teleocichla sudah lama dipastikan' adds 'lama', which is not in the source ('well-established'). Use 'sudah mapan/dipastikan'.
Item 11: 'hingga saat itu' for 'to date' changes the time reference. Use 'sampai saat ini'.

Item 2: the type-locality quote is left in English, with a gloss added. The gloss 'kira-kira 71°55'BB/03°10'LS' is incorrect. 'W' is 'BB' (Bujur Barat), but the coordinate is written 71°55'W/03°10'S and the gloss alters the format. Also, the English 'tributing to' is rendered as 'mengalir ke'. Also, 'Río' is capitalised inconsistently.

Item 5: 'Kerucut alder (buah/kerucut pohon alder)' is an unclear gloss. Use 'buah alder (alder cones)'. 'Siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically-immature' is acceptable, but 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is awkward. Use 'filter spons yang digerakkan udara'.

Item 7: 'kutu air (daphnia, moina)' lumps Artemia out and calls them 'kutu air'. Artemia is brine shrimp, so say 'artemia, daphnia, moina'. 'Pada dasarnya karnivora' for 'chiefly carnivorous' is slightly weaker than 'terutama karnivora'.
Item 1 and item 10: 'larvifor' is not a term Indonesian hobbyists use. The gloss is too long. Use 'pengeram mulut larva'.
Item 4: 'Ukuran alas 60 × 30 cm atau lebih baru cukup memadai' reads awkwardly. 'Baru' could be misread as 'new'. Use 'atau lebih besar'.
Item 5: "Alder cone" left in English; use "kerucut alder" or add a description such as "(buah/kerucut pohon alder)".
Item 1/10: "larviphorous" left untranslated and unexplained; use an Indonesian description (induk membawa burayak di mulut) or put the English term in brackets.
Item 1: "Barlow's dwarf cichlid" left untranslated; add an Indonesian common-name form, e.g. "cichlid kerdil Barlow".
Item 3: "Spesies ikan yang hidup bersamanya" for "sympatric" is acceptable, but "kerabat segenusnya" is awkward; use "sesama anggota genus (A. agassizii)".
Item 2: the type locality quote is left in English; if it is a quote, add an Indonesian gloss.

Item 11: "lineage" and "grup spesies" are mixed; "tribus" is non-standard, use "tribe" or "suku". "Para penghobi ... untuk menghindari" is awkward. "Kesimpulan utama lain ... adalah konfirmasi bahwa" is awkward.
Item 11: "hampir selalu berubah-ubah" is a loose rendering of "near-constant flux"; use "terus berubah".
Item 4: the conversion is correct, but "cukup layak" is vague; "just about acceptable" is better rendered "baru cukup memadai".
Item 10: "Aquarist" is left in English; use "penghobi akuarium". "A. 'sp. Kelleri'" is inconsistent with the earlier A. sp. 'Kelleri' (copied from the source).

Item 3: second sentence omitted: 'The fish offered are quality Betta smaragdina bred by a breeder in Vietnam.' Translation only covers the first sentence (if this is shop talk it may be dropped, but it is a content omission as written).
Item 3: 'habitat' translated as 'akuarium' – minor; fine, but omission is the main issue.
Item 9: 'Salvinia atau Riccia spp.' and 'Cryptocoryne spp.' fine; 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is okay, but 'Penambahan daun kering' drops 'litter' sense; use 'serasah daun kering'.
Item 15: 'riset yang matang' is slightly stiff; 'cyprinid' and 'loach' could use local terms ('ikan cyprinid kecil dan ikan loach/botia').
Item 16: 'kurang hias' is awkward for 'less ornate'; use 'tidak seindah/kurang berumbai'.
Item 20: 'adu ikan yang terorganisir' – 'bouts' is better rendered as 'pertandingan adu ikan'; 'per galur' (line-bred) is unclear—use 'melalui pembiakan galur/silang dalam'.
Item 4: 'lebih keras' for 'harsher environment' okay; 'anggota kelompok splendens' adds 'kelompok' where the English says 'other splendens' (minor).
Item 1: 'kilau biru' for 'blue iridescence' acceptable; 'tahan suhu rendah' fine.
Item 5: "pot tanah liat" adds "clay", which the English ("plant pots") does not say. Use "pot tanaman" or "pot".
Item 7: "larva Chironomus (cacing darah)" narrows "chironomid larvae" to one genus. Use "larva chironomid/Chironomidae (cacing darah)".
Item 1: "menempelkan posisi tubuhnya sejajar dengan permukaan padat" is awkward. Use "sering menempelkan tubuhnya pada permukaan padat" or "menyejajarkan tubuhnya dengan permukaan padat".
Items 1 and 8: "kemungkinan sebaiknya dipelihara" is clumsy for "should probably be kept". Use "sebaiknya dipelihara sendirian" or "mungkin lebih baik dipelihara sendirian".
Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup" / "Ikan umpan" for 'feeder' fish is OK, but "Mysis" and "artemia" casing is inconsistent; keep Latin/genus names consistent (Artemia, Mysis).

"ความสูงเฉลี่ยหลังปลูกในตู้ได้สองเดือน": the English says "after two months in the tank". Use something simpler like "หลังอยู่ในตู้ครบสองเดือน".
"เป็นลิเวอร์เวิร์ตหายากและมีเอกลักษณ์": "distinctive" is rendered awkwardly. "มีเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว" is more natural.
"ที่ชอบที่ร่ม": "shade-loving" is better as "ที่ชอบแสงน้อย" or "ไม้น้ำร่ม", the usual hobby term.
"ลุค" and "เลย์เอาต์": these are colloquial transliterations. "ลักษณะ" and "การจัดตู้" would fit a handbook better.
"มอสที่นิยมใช้ในตู้ปลาทั่วไป": the English says "traditional aquarium mosses". "มอสดั้งเดิม" or "มอสแบบทั่วไปในตู้ไม้น้ำ" is closer. "ตู้ปลา" should also be "ตู้ไม้น้ำ".
"ฟองออกซิเจนเม็ดเล็กคล้ายไข่มุก": "เม็ดเล็ก" is added and "striking" is not translated. The closing "ดูสวยงามโดดเด่น" is padding.
"แหนใหญ่" is acceptable, but Spirodela polyrrhiza is more commonly called "แหนเป็ดใหญ่" or "จอกหูหนูใหญ่" by Thai hobbyists; consider checking the common name.
"ตักออกเป็นประจำ" for "regular thinning" is fine, but "ตักออกบางส่วนเป็นประจำ" would be clearer that only some are removed.
"fronds" translated as "แผ่นใบ" is slightly awkward; "ใบ" or "แผ่นใบเล็ก" would read more naturally.
Item 1: "หลังปลูกในตู้ปลาได้สองเดือน" adds the meaning of "planted"; the English says only "after two months in the tank". Use "หลังอยู่ในตู้สองเดือน".
Item 1: "Light demand: low" and "CO2: low" are rendered "น้อย". For CO2, "ต่ำ" is more natural. "ความต้องการแสง: ต่ำ" is also fine.
Item 2: "ใบเล็ก ๆ" for "fronds". Duckweed has fronds (ลำต้น/แผ่นใบ), not true leaves. This is minor.
Item 2: "Regular thinning is recommended" became "ควรทยอยตักออกเป็นประจำ". "ทยอย" (gradually) is an added nuance. Use "ควรตักออกเป็นประจำ".

Item 2: "Spirodela polyrrhiza" is called "แหนใหญ่" for Greater Duckweed. Spirodela is commonly called "แหนเป็ดใหญ่" or "จอกหูหนู" in Thai hobby usage. Check that the local name is accurate. "แหนใหญ่" is acceptable but not standard.
Item 9: "หอยขมญี่ปุ่น" for Japanese trapdoor snail is not a well-known hobby term; consider "หอยญี่ปุ่น (Japanese trapdoor snail)" or keep the English in brackets.
Item 10: "ผ่านการเซ็ตวงจรไนโตรเจน" adds "nitrogen" to "cycles the substrate". Phrase it more simply, e.g. "ช่วยให้วัสดุปลูกเข้าที่/ผ่านการไซเคิล".
Item 7: temperature 'ideal range' 20–30 °C is fine, but item 1 says 22–30 °C — source inconsistency; keep as is. No change needed here, ignore.

Item 9: 'White Mountain minnows' rendered as 'ปลาคาร์ดินัลจีน' — acceptable; but 'bleeding heart tetra ... neon tetras, mollies, killifish, swordtails' order is shuffled: 'mollies' is missing (ปลาสอด = swordtail, ปลาหางดาบ = also swordtail). Mollies should be 'ปลาโมลลี่' and swordtails 'ปลาสอดหางดาบ/ปลาหางดาบ'; 'ปลาสอด' is wrong for mollies.
Item 9: 'Otocinclus catfish' translated as 'ปลาแคระ Otocinclus' — should be 'ปลาอ๊อตโต้ (Otocinclus)'; 'pygmy Corydoras' as 'ปลาแพะแคระ' — use 'ปลาคอริดอรัสแคระ'.
Item 9: 'clown loaches' translated as 'ปลาหมูอินโด' — wrong fish; clown loach is 'ปลาโคลนโลช/ปลาหมูข้างลาย'. 'koi' translated as 'ปลาคาร์ป' is ok but 'ปลาคาร์ป' loses koi; use 'ปลาคราฟ/โคอิ'.

Item 9: 'Japanese trapdoor snails' as 'หอยขมญี่ปุ่น' and 'ramshorn' as 'หอยเขาแกะ', 'Malaysian trumpet snails' as 'หอยเจดีย์มาเลเซีย', 'rabbit snails' as 'หอยแรบบิท' — terms OK; but 'black devil snails' (หอยแบล็กเดวิล) fine. 'Staurogyne repens กับกุ้งเครย์ฟิช...' fine.
Item 11: 'A sizeable bunch containing up to 10 stems ... 10–20 gallon' converted to '40–75 ลิตร' — 10–20 US gal ≈ 38–76 L, OK. 'Quarantine' as 'กักโรค' OK.
Item 3: 'dicotyledonous floating plants' translated 'พืชใบเลี้ยงคู่ลอยน้ำ' faithful to source error; fine.
Item 12: 'each stem is 3.4 cm wide' → 'แต่ละต้นกว้าง 3.4 ซม.' kept; fine.
Item 8: 'ปุ๋ยฝัง' for root tabs and 'CO2 น้ำ' for liquid CO2 are awkward; use 'ปุ๋ยเม็ดฝังราก' and 'CO2 น้ำ (liquid carbon)'.
Item 8: 'bright illumination' rendered 'แสงสว่าง' is fine; 'Nerite snails' as 'หอยนีไรท์' fine.

Item 4: "Be sure to have the habitat ready before purchase" was rendered as "เตรียมตู้หรือที่ปลูกให้พร้อม". This is a slight reinterpretation, because it adds "ตู้หรือ". Keep it closer to the source, e.g. "เตรียมที่อยู่/ที่ปลูกให้พร้อมก่อนซื้อ".

Item 5: "family Isopterygium" is wrong in the source, because Isopterygium is a genus. The Thai "กลุ่ม" blurs this, which is acceptable. Consider "สกุล" only if correcting is allowed. Otherwise keep "กลุ่ม".
Item 3: "วีปปิ้งมอส" is a transliteration. The common Thai name is "วีปปิ้งมอส", so this is fine, but "ขนาดย่อส่วน" placed after the name reads slightly awkwardly.
Item 1: "ข้อ" for "nodes" is a little unusual. Consider "ข้อ/จุดแตกกิ่ง" for clarity.
Item 4: "ปลานักล่าโดยสมบูรณ์" for "obligate predator" is a stiff literal rendering. Use something like "ปลานักล่าที่กินเนื้อเป็นอาหารเท่านั้น" or "กินปลาอื่นเป็นอาหารหลักตามธรรมชาติ".
Item 4: "เนื้อปลาเนื้อขาวหั่นเป็นชิ้นยาว" is clumsy and repeats "เนื้อ". Use "เนื้อปลาขาวหั่นเป็นแท่งยาว" or "ฟิลเลต์ปลาเนื้อขาวหั่นเป็นเส้น".

Item 3: type locality is left as an English sentence, 'Río Cenepa, Departo. Amazonas, Peru, about 4°28'S, 78°10'W, elevation about 210 meters'. Translate 'about', 'elevation' and 'meters' into Thai (e.g. 'สูงจากระดับน้ำทะเลประมาณ 210 เมตร'). Keep the place names in Latin script.
Items 1, 6: 'ปลาที่อาศัยในแม่น้ำน้ำไหล' for 'fluvial' is clumsy and repeats itself. Use 'ปลาที่อาศัยในแม่น้ำ/น้ำไหล'.
Item 11: 'ป่าดิบ' for 'jungle' narrows the meaning (it means primary or evergreen forest). 'ป่าดงดิบ' or 'ป่า' fits better.
Item 10: 'ชนเผ่าอินเดียนเปรู' is awkward. Use 'ชนพื้นเมืองเปรู' or 'ชนเผ่าพื้นเมืองในเปรู'.

Item 9: 'The former ... not in the aquarium trade with little to no export' is rendered 'ไม่มีในวงการปลาสวยงาม เพราะแทบไม่มีหรือไม่มีการส่งออก' — it changes the meaning into a causal 'because' and is awkward. Rewrite as 'ไม่พบในวงการปลาสวยงาม และแทบไม่มีการส่งออกจากทะเลสาบ Mai-Ndombe'.
Item 9: 'Alestinae (containing all other alestids)' became 'มีปลาในวงศ์นี้ที่เหลือทั้งหมด', which is clumsy. Use 'มีปลาในวงศ์ Alestidae ที่เหลือทั้งหมด'.

Item 9: 'later studies strongly rejected monophyly' was translated as 'ปฏิเสธอย่างชัดเจนว่ากลุ่มเหล่านี้ไม่ใช่กลุ่มที่มีบรรพบุรุษร่วมเดียวกัน'. This is a confusing double negative. Say 'ปฏิเสธว่ากลุ่มเหล่านี้เป็นกลุ่มที่มีบรรพบุรุษร่วมกัน (monophyly)'.
Item 9: 'Hydrocynus goliath' is called 'ปลาเสือโกไลแอท', a transliteration that hobbyists rarely use. Use 'ปลาเสือคองโก' or 'ไทเกอร์ฟิชโกไลแอท'.

Item 9: Heading wording 'ผู้วิจัยทั้งสอง' for Zanata and Vari is fine, but the many untranslated technical terms (paraphyletic, monophyletic, premaxilla) are left in English. Add Thai equivalents, e.g. 'พาราฟีเลติก' and 'กระดูกพรีแม็กซิลลา'.
Item 7: 'ปลาหมู' is used for loaches. Hobbyists in Thailand usually say 'ปลาหมูอารีย์' or 'ปลาจิ้งจก'. 'ปลาตะเพียน' for cyprinids is OK, but 'ปลาหนัง' for catfishes is a loose rendering.
#1 "ปลาดุกแบนโจ": hobbyists usually say "ปลาแบนโจ" or "แบนโจแคทฟิช". "ปลาดุก" may suggest the wrong fish.
#8 "อาหารเม็ดแบบแผ่นจม (แท็บเล็ต)": the English only says "Tablet foods". "จม" (sinking) is an addition, so use "อาหารเม็ดแท็บเล็ต".
#11 "นักสัตว์เลื้อยคลานวิทยา": herpetology also covers amphibians. "นักสัตว์เลื้อยคลานและสะเทินน้ำสะเทินบก" or "นักวิทยาสัตว์เลื้อยคลาน" would be more exact.
#7/#8: 'แทบเป็นอาหารหลักเพียงอย่างเดียว' is garbled; 'almost exclusively' should be 'เกือบทั้งหมด' / 'เกือบเฉพาะ'. Rephrase as 'กินไข่และลูกปลาแรกฟัก...เป็นอาหารเกือบทั้งหมด'.
#8: 'tubifex' is translated as 'ไส้เดือนน้ำ'. Hobbyists in Thailand say 'หนอนแดง' or 'ไส้เดือนน้ำ (tubifex)', and 'ไส้เดือนน้ำ' can mean other worms, so the term is imprecise. Use 'ไทรเฟกซ์/หนอนแดง'.
#8: 'รับอาหารเม็ดแบบเม็ดอัดแผ่น (tablet)' is awkward. Use 'อาหารเม็ดแบบแผ่นจม/แท็บเล็ต'.
#1: 'inch' became '2.5 ซม.', which is correct, but 'ไม่ยอมว่ายไปไหน' loses the idiom slightly. This is minor.

#11: 'Amaralia มาจาก -ia ที่แปลว่า เป็นของ นักสัตววิทยา...' is a clumsy rendering of the etymology. The meaning of 'belonging to' (honouring) is unclear. Also 'herpetologist' became 'นักสัตววิทยาด้านสัตว์เลื้อยคลานและสะเทินน้ำสะเทินบก', which is OK. Use 'นักสัตว์เลื้อยคลานวิทยา'.
#11: 'slender 2 rayed dorsal fin' as 'ครีบหลังเรียวเล็กที่มีก้านครีบ 2 ก้าน' is acceptable. But #2 'Two Rayed' is left in English, which is fine.
Item 3: 'Origin: Brazil' is translated faithfully, but it conflicts with the Peru-only distribution elsewhere. This is a source issue, so no change is needed.
Item 23: 'semi-aquatic reeds' became 'พืชน้ำคล้ายอ้อหรือต้นกก'. This adds 'คล้ายอ้อหรือ' and loosens the meaning. Use 'ต้นอ้อกึ่งน้ำ' or 'กอไม้กึ่งน้ำ'.
Item 23: 'There is but a single breeding report' became 'รายงานการเพาะพันธุ์เพียงฉบับเดียว'. The context is a wild breeding observation, so 'รายงานการสืบพันธุ์' fits better than 'การเพาะพันธุ์'.
Item 15: 'granular varieties' became 'อาหารเม็ดเล็กแบบแกรนูล'. The wording is redundant. 'อาหารเม็ดแกรนูล' is enough.
Item 24: 'ซึ่งปัจจุบันถือเป็นชื่อพ้อง' leaves it unclear what the name is a synonym of. The sentence also loses 'previously thought to be'. Rephrase it more clearly.
Item 16: 'ปลากินอาหารส่วนใหญ่อย่างตะกละ' is a little ambiguous. Use 'ปลารับอาหารได้เกือบทุกชนิดอย่างตะกละตะกลาม'.
Item 19: 'ก็เจ็บแน่นอน' loses the 'ouch!' tone. Use 'โอ๊ย เจ็บแน่!' or similar.
Item 22: 'ยังไม่เคยมีรายงานการเพาะพันธุ์สำเร็จ' adds 'report'. The source says 'Not yet achieved'. Use 'ยังไม่สามารถเพาะพันธุ์ได้สำเร็จในที่เลี้ยง'.
Item 15: 'granular varieties' is rendered as 'อาหารแบบเกล็ดเล็ก' (flake-like). Granules are 'อาหารเม็ดเล็ก/แบบแกรนูล'. Use that to avoid confusion with flake food.
Item 23: 'กอกก' for 'semi-aquatic reeds' is an odd, unclear term. Use 'กอพืชน้ำคล้ายอ้อ/ต้นกก' or 'ต้นอ้อกึ่งน้ำ'.
Item 22: 'ยังไม่มีการเพาะพันธุ์ได้ในที่เลี้ยง' is awkward. Use 'ยังไม่เคยมีรายงานการเพาะพันธุ์สำเร็จในที่เลี้ยง'.
Item 14: 'ถูกความร้อนลวกได้' is slightly off for burns from a heater. Use 'ถูกความร้อนลวก/ไหม้'. 'กระจกตู้' is fine.
Item 23: 'การสืบพันธุ์ในธรรมชาติว่ามีการก่อหวอด' is clumsy and the 'in the aquarium' and 'in nature' contrast is muddled. Rephrase it as 'ในธรรมชาติมีรายงานว่าก่อหวอดในพืชน้ำ'.
Item 17: 'ปลาแพะ Corydoras' is a possible mix-up. Thai hobbyists use 'ปลาคอรี่/คอรี่ดอรัส' for Corydoras. 'ปลาแพะ' is a different fish.
Item 6: 'ติเกร' for the Tigre river is unnatural. Add 'แม่น้ำ' to each river name for clarity.
Item 21: 'ผู้เลี้ยงบางรายรายงานว่า' and 'จุดกระ' are stiff. Use 'ผู้เลี้ยงบางคนแจ้งว่า' and 'มีจุดประ'.
Item 4: "คำกริยาภาษาละติน rectus" renders "Latin participle" as plain "verb". Use "กริยาวิเศษณ์ (participle) ภาษาละติน" or "คำภาษาละติน rectus".
Items 1–2: "เลโกนี" for Léconi is a loose transliteration. Consider "เลโกนี" or "เลกอนี" used consistently, which is minor.
Items 1 and 8: "แย่งอาหารและพื้นที่สู้ปลาชนิดอื่นไม่ได้" adds "food and space". The English only says "does not compete well". Use a plainer phrase such as "สู้ปลาชนิดอื่นไม่ได้".
Item 11: "นักอนุกรมวิธานบางท่าน" renders "some authors". Use "ผู้เขียนบางท่าน" or "นักวิชาการบางท่าน" to stay closer to the source.
Item 10: "สามารถฟักไข่ได้ทั้งในน้ำ หรือวางไข่บนชั้นพีทมอส" is awkward. It should be "ฟักไข่ได้ทั้งในน้ำ หรือวางไข่ไว้บนชั้นพีทมอสชื้น", with the verb for placing the eggs made clearer.
Item 10: "ควรรู้ไว้ว่าการกรองด้วยพีทมีประโยชน์" is stiff for "bear in mind that peat filtration is beneficial". "การกรองผ่านพีทก็มีประโยชน์" is more natural.
Item 10: "ลูกไรทะเลแรกฟัก" is an unusual term. Use "ไรทะเลแรกฟัก (brine shrimp nauplii)" or "อาร์ทีเมียแรกฟัก", which hobbyists commonly use.

Item 11: "mop วางไข่ที่ทำจากไหมพรม" adds a fact. The English says only "artificial spawning mops" and says nothing about yarn. Drop "ที่ทำจากไหมพรม", or write "ม็อบวางไข่เทียม". "mop" is also left in Latin letters in the other mentions in the same item.
Items 1 and 7: "ความกระด้าง (GH)" adds "GH", but the English says only "Hardness" with a dGH value. This is minor. Use "ความกระด้าง: 3–12 dGH" to stay faithful.
Item 11: "กระเป๋าเสื้อผ้า" for "pocket" is awkward. Use "กระเป๋าเสื้อ" or "กระเป๋ากางเกง".
Item 5: 'every few weeks' became 'ทุกๆ 2–3 สัปดาห์', which adds a specific number the source doesn't give. Use 'ทุกๆ สองสามสัปดาห์'.
Item 11: 'lineage' as 'สายวงศ์' and 'sublineage' as 'สายวงศ์ย่อย' read stiffly. 'สายสายพันธุ์' or 'สายวิวัฒนาการ' would be clearer, or keep the English term in brackets.
Item 3: 'white water' as 'น้ำขุ่นขาว' is slightly interpretive. 'น้ำขาว' is the usual hobby term.

Item 5: 'Ketapang almond leaves' translated as 'ใบหูกวาง' but the source's 'beech, oak or Ketapang almond leaves' is rendered as 'ใบบีช ใบโอ๊ก หรือใบหูกวาง' – fine; however 'ใบไม้ที่เน่าเปื่อย' for decaying leaves is slightly off, use 'ใบไม้ที่ย่อยสลาย'.

Item 11: 'Kullander ... six subfamilies' translated as 'หกวงศ์ย่อย' with 'วงศ์ Cichlidae ในเขตร้อนของทวีปอเมริกา (neotropical)' – acceptable, but 'วงศ์ย่อยที่เสนอไว้ Geophaginae' is clumsy; rephrase to 'วงศ์ย่อย Geophaginae (ซึ่งยังเป็นข้อเสนอ)'.
Item 11: 'Satanoperca clade' sentence moves 'well-supported' into a relative clause, 'ที่มีหลักฐานสนับสนุนหนักแน่น', placed before the members; this is awkward, put it after the name more clearly.
Item 11: 'Hobbyists tend to label these' translated as 'ติดป้าย' – use 'ระบุชื่อกำกับ' to be more natural.
Item 11: 'Presumably...lateral lines in member species' – 'ไม่เท่ากัน' for 'variably-developed' is imprecise; use 'พัฒนาแตกต่างกันไปในแต่ละชนิด'.

Item 7: 'Artemia' rendered as 'ไรทะเล' – hobbyists in Thailand usually say 'อาร์ทีเมีย'; 'ไรแดง' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'chironomid larvae (bloodworm)' as 'หนอนแดง' omits the chironomid larva (ลูกน้ำ/ตัวอ่อนแมลงหวี่); add 'ตัวอ่อนของ chironomid'.
Item 2: 'affluent' is rendered as 'สาขา'; 'Department' as 'จังหวัด' is a reasonable choice, but Colombia's departamento would be better as 'แผนก/department' – consider 'จังหวัด (department)'.

Item 3: 'with the type locality a roadside pool' – 'type locality' translated as 'แหล่งที่พบตัวอย่างต้นแบบ' fine; item 11: 'DATZ' expansion 'Die Aquarien- und Terrarienzeitschrift' added, which is an added fact not in the source.

Item 20: 'grouped arbitrarily' became 'ไม่เป็นทางการ' (informally). Arbitrary means a grouping by convenience or without a natural basis, e.g. 'แบ่งกลุ่มตามความสะดวก/ไม่ได้อิงความสัมพันธ์ทางวิวัฒนาการ'.

Items 15 and 17: 'Females can be extremely difficult to identify' became 'แยกเพศหรือแยกชนิดได้ยากมาก'. 'แยกเพศ' (sexing) is added; the source means telling the species of females apart. Use 'แยกชนิดได้ยาก'.
Item 12: 'peat-safe materials' became 'วัสดุจำพวกพีทที่ปลอดภัยต่อปลา'. This adds a claim about the material being peat-type. Keep it close to the source, e.g. 'วัสดุที่ปลอดภัยสำหรับน้ำพีท'.

Item 1: 'Endangered' translated as 'ใกล้สูญพันธุ์' (that is Near Threatened). Use 'ใกล้สูญพันธุ์อย่างยิ่ง' or 'ตกอยู่ในภาวะใกล้สูญพันธุ์' for IUCN EN. The same error is in items 3, 15 and 21 ('endangered' / 'listed as Endangered').

Item 10: the English gives 24–26 °C for routine maintenance and 22–28 °C overall. The Thai keeps the numbers and the °F is rightly dropped, but 'ค่าการนำไฟฟ้าต่ำมากเป็นอย่างยิ่ง' is redundant and awkward. Say 'ค่าการนำไฟฟ้าต่ำมาก'.
Item 9: 'ลูกสนอัลเดอร์ (alder cone)' is wrong. Alder cones are catkins or cones of the alder tree, not pine cones. Use 'ผลอัลเดอร์' or 'โคนอัลเดอร์'. The same error is in item 12.
Item 12: 'วัสดุที่ปลอดภัยสำหรับตู้แบบพรุ' mistranslates 'peat-safe materials'. The meaning is unclear, so rephrase it. 'ระบบกรองควรนุ่มนวล' is also unnatural. Say 'กรองควรให้แรงน้ำเบา'.

Item 13: 'ไรแดง (Moina) และไรแดง (daphnia)' uses the same Thai name for two different organisms. Moina is usually 'ไรแดง' or 'ไรน้ำนางฟ้า', and Daphnia is 'ไรน้ำ' or 'ไรแดง', so keep them distinct. 'ในที่สุดปลาอาจยอมรับ' for 'eventually' is acceptable.
Item 9: 'ผู้เพาะพันธุ์หลายคนนิยมไม่ใช้วัสดุปูพื้น' is slightly awkward. 'ตู้ที่วงจรไนโตรเจนยังไม่สมบูรณ์' adds a nitrogen-cycle concept in place of 'biologically-immature'. This is a minor point.
Item 16: 'ปลาตระกูลปลาซิว' for cyprinids is loose. Boraras and Sundadanio are small cyprinids or rasboras, so say 'ปลาในวงศ์ปลาตะเพียน (ปลาซิว) ขนาดเล็ก'.
Item 20: 'ตัวผู้จะอยู่ในท่า … ขึ้นอยู่กับชนิด' is fine. 'ปลาโตที่ยังไม่มีประสบการณ์' is acceptable. Item 22: 'วงศ์ย่อย' for 'subfamily' is correct, but 'อันดับย่อย Anabantoidei' is fine.

Item 17: 'ส่วนตัวเมียแยกชนิดได้ยากมาก' mistranslates 'Females can be extremely difficult to identify'. Add 'แยกเพศหรือชนิด' to make clear it means identifying the sex or species. The same applies to the wording in item 15.
